cues.title: 盐水和水封承担不同作用
cues.titleEn: Brine and the seal have different roles
cues.caption: 菜料在液面下，坛盖裙边插在水槽中。
cues.captionEn: Food stays below brine; the lid skirt enters the water trough.
cues.zh: 先看剖面：菜料浸没在盐水下，顶部留出空间。坛盖边缘插入外侧水槽，减少空气进入；水槽干涸后，这个边界就失效。水封和菜料上方的盐水不是同一层液体。
cues.en: In section, vegetables remain below the brine with space above. The lid skirt sits in an outer water trough to limit air entry. A dry trough loses that boundary. The sealing water is separate from the food brine.

cues.title: 发酵进程需要实际记录
cues.caption: 这里选择乳酸生成的简化路径，不预测可食用时间。
cues.captionEn: This selected lactic pathway does not predict edibility.
cues.zh: 乳酸菌利用糖，产物逐渐积累。模型只选择同型乳酸发酵，高盐会降低示意速率。打开空气并不等于所有乳酸菌立刻停止活动；真实菌群、温度和品质仍需记录。
cues.en: Lactic bacteria use sugars and products accumulate. This model selects homolactic fermentation, with high salt reducing the illustrative rate. Air exposure does not instantly stop every lactic bacterium. Real communities, temperature and quality require observations.

cues.title: 不同取样日，答案为何不同
cues.caption: 独立时点的记录，先升后降。
cues.captionEn: Separate time points show a rise and fall.
cues.zh: 教材这组记录中，亚硝酸盐先升后降。每个点来自不同取样日，不是一管液体反复变色。先取有代表性的样品，再保留提取、移取和稀释的量。蔬菜中的硝酸盐可被一些微生物还原成亚硝酸盐，亚硝酸盐也会被后续过程去除。同一曲线并不能告诉我们，具体是哪一种菌或哪一种酶在作用。
cues.en: In this textbook example, nitrite first rises, then falls. Each point belongs to a separate sampling day, not one tube repeatedly changing color. Take representative samples and preserve extraction, transfer and dilution quantities. Some microbes can reduce vegetable nitrate to nitrite; later processes can also remove nitrite. This curve alone cannot identify which organism or enzyme caused the change.

cues.title: 存量由生成与去除共同决定
cues.titleEn: Formation and removal determine the stock
cues.caption: 跟住同一份氮，比较进入和离开。
cues.captionEn: Track the same nitrogen into and out of the pool.
cues.zh: 每个时点都需要空白与标准校准，稀释倍数也要保存。现在换成解释模型：标记追踪同一份氮，不是完整化学反应。生成比去除快，亚硝酸盐积累；去除占优势，存量下降。保持生成过程相同，如果后续去除更快呢？先预测，再重算：积累更少。真实条件还需多时点取样检验，不能据此给所有泡菜规定一个安全天数。
cues.en: Use blanks and standards at each time point, keeping the dilution factor. Now switch to an explanatory model. Markers track the same nitrogen, not complete chemical reactions. Faster formation builds the nitrite stock; faster removal lowers it. Keep formation unchanged: what if removal is faster? Predict first, then rerun the model: less accumulates. Test real conditions with multiple sampling times. This does not establish a universal safe fermentation day.

cues.title: 糖转成乙醇，碳也进入气体
cues.titleEn: Sugar forms ethanol and gaseous carbon
cues.caption: 理想反应同时生成乙醇和二氧化碳。
cues.captionEn: The ideal reaction forms both ethanol and carbon dioxide.
cues.zh: 酵母的酒精发酵把一摩尔葡萄糖转成两摩尔乙醇和两摩尔二氧化碳。碳没有凭空消失，一部分沿气体通路离开。真实培养还会形成菌体和其他产物，这里只算主反应。
cues.en: Ideal alcoholic fermentation converts one mole of glucose to two moles each of ethanol and carbon dioxide. Carbon is retained in products, including gas leaving the vessel. Real cultures also produce biomass and other compounds; only the main reaction is balanced here.

cues.title: 限制空气进入，同时留出排气路径
cues.titleEn: Limit incoming air while venting gas
cues.caption: 气泡沿瓶颈和水弯离开，不穿过瓶壁。
cues.captionEn: Gas follows the neck and water bend, never the bottle wall.
cues.zh: 瓶内留有空间，产生的气体沿瓶颈进入排气水弯，再从出口离开。本图是排气装置重建；教材采用定时松盖。酿酒条件并不意味着把正在产气的容器完全封死。
cues.en: Headspace remains above the liquid. Produced gas travels through the neck, water bend and outlet. This is an airlock reconstruction; the textbook uses scheduled cap loosening. Fermentation conditions do not mean sealing a gas-producing vessel without an outlet.

cues.title: 醋酸菌需要新的供氧条件
cues.caption: 乙醇氧化为乙酸，需要从外界供给氧气。
cues.captionEn: Oxidizing ethanol to acetic acid requires external oxygen.
cues.zh: 切换到醋酸发酵，纱布保留气体交换通路。氧气进入液体，乙醇才按所选反应生成乙酸和水。关闭供氧，模型不继续转化；这并不表示任意开盖果酒都会按计划成为果醋。
cues.en: For vinegar, gauze preserves gas exchange. Oxygen enters the liquid, allowing ethanol to form acetic acid and water in the selected reaction. Without oxygen the model stops conversion. Simply opening any bottle does not guarantee controlled vinegar production.

cues.title: 大罐不是按比例放大的小瓶
cues.titleEn: A large tank changes transport demands
cues.caption: 相似放大时，面积增长慢于体积。
cues.captionEn: With similar scaling, surface area grows slower than volume.
cues.zh: 相似罐的线性尺寸加倍，体积变成八倍，表面积只有四倍。单位体积可用的传热面积下降。工业化还要解决供氧、混合、散热和污染控制，不能只把家庭方法的用量放大。
cues.en: Doubling every dimension gives eight times the volume but four times the surface area. Heat-transfer area per unit volume falls. Industrial production must address oxygen, mixing, cooling and contamination control, rather than simply multiplying a small recipe.

cues.title: 比较流程需要有出处的资料
cues.caption: 菌种、灭菌、发酵与分离分别留下依据。
cues.captionEn: Document strain, sterilization, fermentation and recovery separately.
cues.zh: 查阅一个具体果酒或果醋生产流程，逐项比较菌种来源、设备灭菌、条件监测和产物分离。记录工艺年代、规模和资料出处。这里提供调查顺序，不把流程动画当成已经完成的工厂调查。
cues.en: Investigate a specific wine or vinegar process. Compare strain sources, equipment sterilization, process monitoring and recovery. Record date, scale and source. The sequence guides an investigation; it does not pretend that a factory study has already been completed.

cues.title: 部件要连到真正工作的地方
cues.titleEn: Connect each component to its working location
cues.caption: 空气到达底部散气器，电机连接叶轮。
cues.captionEn: Air reaches the bottom sparger; the motor connects to impellers.
cues.zh: 跟着空气进入底部散气器，再沿液体上升并从顶部排出。电机轴连接浸在液体中的叶轮。冷却水走外侧夹套，传感器接触培养液；这些连接承担不同任务，不能混成同一条管路。
cues.en: Follow air into the bottom sparger, upward through liquid and out at the top. The motor shaft connects submerged impellers. Cooling water uses an outer jacket while sensors contact the broth. These paths have distinct functions and must remain separate.

cues.title: 溶氧取决于传入和消耗
cues.titleEn: Dissolved oxygen balances transfer and use
cues.caption: 供氧与搅拌改变传质，微生物持续耗氧。
cues.captionEn: Aeration and mixing affect transfer while microbes consume oxygen.
cues.zh: 先看通气，再看停止通气的对照。液体中的溶氧由气液传入和微生物消耗共同决定。探索时关闭搅拌，示意传质系数下降；关闭空气后也不会把已有溶氧瞬间删除。
cues.en: Compare supplied air with stopped aeration. Dissolved oxygen reflects transfer from gas minus microbial consumption. In exploration, stopping mixing lowers the illustrative transfer coefficient. Stopping air does not instantly erase oxygen already dissolved in the liquid.

cues.title: 冷却夹套改变的是热量收支
cues.titleEn: The jacket changes the heat balance
cues.caption: 产热仍在继续，夹套把热量带走。
cues.captionEn: Heat production continues while the jacket removes heat.
cues.zh: 比较关闭和开启冷却的温度变化。示意模型持续产热，夹套通过与冷却水的温差带走热量。通气、搅拌和温度都应服务于所选菌种与产品；这里的参数不是实际生产设定。
cues.en: Compare temperature with cooling off and on. Heat production continues, while the jacket removes heat through the temperature difference. Aeration, mixing and temperature must suit the chosen organism and product. These illustrative parameters are not production settings.

question.zh: 为什么水封完整，坛中仍会生成乳酸？
question.en: Why can lactate form inside a sealed jar?

lead.zh: 水封限制空气交换，微生物的发酵代谢仍可继续。
lead.en: The seal limits air exchange while fermentation can continue.

principle.zh: 水封限制空气交换，微生物的发酵代谢仍可继续。
principle.en: The seal limits air exchange while fermentation can continue.

question.zh: 水槽干了，是否意味着所有乳酸菌立即停止？
question.en: Does a dry trough instantly stop every lactic bacterium?

explanation.zh: 不能。氧耐受性与菌群不同，不能把水封当成代谢总开关。
explanation.en: No. Oxygen tolerance and communities differ; the seal is not a universal metabolic switch.

question.zh: 为何同一坛在不同日检测，会得到不同结果？
question.en: Why do different sampling days give different results?

lead.zh: 浓度由生成与去除共同决定，独立取样与校准才能比较。
lead.en: Formation and removal jointly determine concentration; compare independent calibrated samples.

principle.zh: 浓度由生成与去除共同决定，独立取样与校准才能比较。
principle.en: Formation and removal jointly determine concentration; compare independent calibrated samples.

question.zh: 如果生成过程不变，后续去除更快，怎样检验预测？
question.en: With the same formation but faster removal, how would you test the prediction?

explanation.zh: 模型预计积累更少；要保留相同测量方法和多时点记录，不能只凭一次结果判断。
explanation.en: The model predicts less accumulation. Preserve measurement conditions and multiple time points rather than relying on one result.

question.zh: 同样的果汁，为什么能先成为酒，再成为醋？
question.en: Why can the same juice become wine and then vinegar?

lead.zh: 不同代谢路径有不同产物与氧条件，碳与外部输入必须一起记账。
lead.en: Different pathways have different products and oxygen requirements; account for carbon and external inputs.

principle.zh: 不同代谢路径有不同产物与氧条件，碳与外部输入必须一起记账。
principle.en: Different pathways have different products and oxygen requirements; account for carbon and external inputs.

question.zh: 已有乙醇但没有氧，所选乙酸生成反应还能继续吗？
question.en: With ethanol but no oxygen, can the selected acetic-acid reaction continue?

explanation.zh: 本模型不能；未反应乙醇保留，实际还需合适菌种与条件。
explanation.en: Not in this model; ethanol remains. Real conversion also requires suitable organisms and conditions.

question.zh: 线性尺寸翻倍，为什么不能只把原料乘八？
question.en: Why is scaling up more than multiplying ingredients by eight?

lead.zh: 体积比面积增长更快，单位体积可用的传热与交换面积下降。
lead.en: Volume grows faster than area, reducing exchange area per unit volume.

principle.zh: 体积比面积增长更快，单位体积可用的传热与交换面积下降。
principle.en: Volume grows faster than area, reducing exchange area per unit volume.

question.zh: 较大的罐需要优先检查哪些记录？
question.en: Which records matter when scaling up?

explanation.zh: 检查菌种、灭菌、溶氧、混合、温度与分离依据；图示不能替代实际工艺调查。
explanation.en: Check strain, sterilization, oxygen, mixing, temperature and recovery evidence; an animation is not a factory investigation.

question.zh: 停掉空气后，溶氧为什么不会立刻归零？
question.en: Why does dissolved oxygen persist after air stops?

lead.zh: 已有库存由传入与消耗共同改变，热量也由产热与散热收支决定。
lead.en: Existing oxygen changes through transfer and use; heat also follows production and removal.

principle.zh: 已有库存由传入与消耗共同改变，热量也由产热与散热收支决定。
principle.en: Existing oxygen changes through transfer and use; heat also follows production and removal.

question.zh: 停止通气与关闭冷却，会留下怎样不同的变化？
question.en: How do stopping air and stopping cooling differ?

explanation.zh: 在相同历史条件下，前者让氧库存逐步耗尽，后者使热量更难排出；两者不是同一条通路。
explanation.en: With the same prior history, oxygen is gradually used up without air, while less heat escapes without cooling; these are separate paths.
